deduplication: GitHub Git blob SHA-1; all observed repo/ref/path locations retained under artifacts.
fresh_byte_verification: Every cached TIFF was downloaded from a pinned GitHub path and its byte length and Git blob SHA-1 were rechecked; raw SHA-256 is stored per unique blob. Supplemental GEMSDOE40 blobs were read from the pinned origin/main Git tree, matched their Git blob SHA-1 and byte size, and have SHA-256 values stored in this addendum.
scope: Conservative public-artifact scan of every GEMS/DOE-named repository visible under the owner at snapshot time. Includes TIFFs under downloads/, docs/downloads/, submissions/, docs/archive/, root docs files named as submissions, and research/evidence files whose basename identifies a submission. Includes published and archived/experimental predictions; excludes source rasters, labels, sample templates, and unrelated TIFFs. Public/unlisted/private repositories and future revisions are outside scope.

supplemental_addendum.reason: The branch started at cddc3ba before main advanced; origin/main now contains public GEMSDOE40 GeoTIFF outputs that were absent from the original corpus. Add these pre-existing repo outputs to the comparison/uniqueness inventory.
